title: Methods and literature
intro: Each model on this site builds on published work. This page names that work and puts our numbers next to the published ones. It also lists every test we set up before it ran, and what each test found. A test that falls short stays on the page.

read.title: How to read this page
lines: Our numbers are copied from the reports in the code. Each one links to its file.
Published numbers are quoted from the notes we keep for each model. Those notes cite the paper and the table the number comes from.
Few papers measure a number the way we do. So each pair carries a verdict, quoted from those notes, on how far the two can be compared.
Each new test had its bar fixed before it ran. It runs first on the training games, then once on games set apart for it. It is adopted only if it clears the bar on both.
read.kinds: The verdicts fall into three kinds

status.development_met_test_pending: Cleared its bar on training games. Test score pending.
status.not_adopted_development: Fell short on training games. Not adopted.
status.adopted: Cleared its bar on training games and on the test games. Adopted.
status.not_adopted_test: Fell short on the test games. Not adopted.

protocol.postHocNote: A range marked post hoc was drawn after the result, by resampling players, and no verdict reads it. The ranges set up in advance resampled games. Those are not valid ranges, so they are not shown.
